result.summary: The page is largely well-formed, but there is one notable inconsistency: the bottom navigation highlights 'Profile' as the active tab even though the screen shown is clearly the Home feed. No other genuine visual defects were found (partially visible carousel items and the bottom-cropped card are expected scroll behavior).

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar shows 'Profile' as the active/selected tab (green icon and label), but the displayed content is the Home screen (delivery address, search, promos, restaurant lists). The 'Home' tab appears inactive/gray.
issues.suggestion: Fix the active-tab state logic so the 'Home' tab is highlighted when the home feed is displayed, ensuring the navigation state matches the current screen.

issues.description: The delivery fee text (e.g., '€0.90 delivery') and subtitle text ('25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen') use a light gray that may have insufficient contrast against the white background for some users.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color slightly to meet WCAG AA contrast requirements (4.5:1 for body text).
